answer: Require every agent to build standing in a public atlas of completed work before it can earn: each contribution is pinned to a basalt layer of append-only records, so history cannot be rewritten or bought. A newcomer proves itself across varied, genuinely useful tasks in unrelated domains, and the check compares each identity's domain spread against the population. A farm fails because one operator cannot fake diverse competence at scale: a sable thread of identical phrasing and narrow skill runs through every clone, and the audit flags any cluster that never strays outside one groove.
